t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. O Kamogo God, nabame kinigi lelo. Embame naba wasii, nabame emba lao masatale lao wasii, nambame emba lao maso loma satale lao wasii. Nabame idupa gii ogonya pudu kaliipi ko minao katalo. Embae putakigi ogome naba kamepipi. Embamee naba iso katape, ebae oa pii auu pipae dupa dipi. Yu tara upa pitakae God emba yalee mede nakalyamo—emba iki, embame naba pudupi, mana kooyape pilyo ogopa nisigi. Emba Kamogo God, medeme wasala nae. Emba me kataoka karege.
